title: Psalm 91:11-13 — angels guard you; you will tread on the lion and the serpent
summary: Psalm 91:11-13 in English: angels guard and lift you up so you do not strike your foot on a stone, and verse 13 adds that you will tread on the lion and the cobra and trample the great lion and the serpent. Verse 13 appears in larger type below verses 11-12 (the part the devil left out).

text.text: 11 For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;
12 they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
13 You will tread on the lion and the cobra; you will trample the great lion and the serpent.
